cases.name: David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc.
Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc.
David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc.
Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc

profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY, with a recently announced European headquarters in London. The company describes itself as building foundational "Real-World Intelligence" capable of understanding, simulating, and acting in the world, with products and services built on top of that foundation. Its core technology is GWM-1, which it calls a state-of-the-art General World Model intended to interact with the real world and serve as a step toward universal simulation. Offerings built on GWM-1 span policy inference, evaluation, and synthetic data generation, and the company has also introduced Runway Media Router, described as the first preference-optimized router for generative media, available through its Runway Dev platform. The company has announced a planned $100 million investment in the UK AI ecosystem alongside the London expansion.

Runway's primary tracked product is its video generation platform, also called Runway, available at runwayml.com. The company has published findings from what it describes as hundreds of enterprises using Runway for media production, citing cost and speed gains in that context.

On the litigation side, Runway AI, Inc. is named as a defendant in several federal cases, including three actions brought separately by David Vance Gardner and Businessing LLC in the Southern District of New York, a case brought by Ace Cam, Inc. also in the Southern District of New York, and a second Gardner action in the Central District of California. Runway is also listed as a party in the Andersen v. Stability AI matter filed in the Northern District of California.
